title: Christa Ingabire
text:
Background
I am from Kigali, Rwanda and I worked as a data engineer for government social security institution. Previously, I worked as a software developer for an IT consulting company, Logisolve, based in the Twin Cities, Minnesota in the U.S. I graduated college in 2023 from Saint Mary’s University of Minnesota in Winona, Minnesota, United States. Before that, I lived in Chicago during high school.


Why data science
Ever since I became conscious of the job of data scientists, I was interested in that kind of work. After working as a data engineer and learning about the power of data and how much it could be used to generate powerful insights, I became interested in actively pursuing a data science degree to learn the proper tools, skills, and techniques of data science.


Outside of data science
Outside of data science I enjoy spending time outside whether it is going on nature walks or hiking. I enjoy visitng museums, parks, and travelling. I also enjoy going to coffee shops and restaurants.
